model: DarkHistory old-method HI/HeI/HeII excitation, ionization and Coulomb drag; absolute proper seconds; source formulas only, no complete-cooling transfer matrix
density_convention: nHe=nH*Y/(4*(1-Y)); ne=nH*xHII+nHe*(xHeII+2*xHeIII); cm^-3=n_m^-3*1e-6. No upstream default Y or cosmological nH is imported.
cutoff: Electrons at/below 10 eV enter an inert unresolved electron-count and kinetic-energy reservoir. This is not prompt heat. No model below cutoff is adopted.
discretization: Linear number-and-energy preserving daughter projection; paired ionization daughters E1+E2=E-I; normalized conditional Shull shape exponent 2.1; raw n*sigma*v event rate; nearest-lower-node conservative Coulomb drift

acceptance.time_method: SSPRK2 steps with max step*max_exit<=0.4, refinements /2 and /4, compared with sparse exponential action

next_on_pass: Independent review and a separately bounded source convolution/extension contract; retain full CR history HOLD
